claims.text: His rule coincided with the end of the Watchful Peace, when Sauron returned to Dol Guldur with increased strength. Also during his rule, orcs began to increase and multiply in the Misty Mountains; it was then when they revealed themselves, waylaying Celebrían and her escort.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, Appendix B, "The Third Age"; J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, Appendix A, "The Númenorean Kings", "Eriador, Arnor, and the Heirs of Isildur"

claims.text: Arahad died in , after having ruled for sixty-eight years, and was followed by his son, Aragost.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, Appendix A, "The Númenorean Kings", "The Realms in Exile", "The Northern Line: Heirs of Isildur"
